cases.setup: Owner record, exact dependency/source identities, operator/host availability and approved limits are supplied.
cases.action: Review approvals and published source; verify LabeledBy and container ScrollPattern are supported before any window is started.
cases.expected: Written scope/budget approval and defensible public provider support; otherwise NO-GO. No GUI starts while known gaps remain.
cases.evidence: Signed/attributed decision reference; source/version/checksum audit; named host/operator and numeric budget profile.
cases.blocking_condition: Missing approval, label/scroll support, named operator, supported host profile or approved bounds.

cases.setup: Fixed empty, one-row and multirow catalogs in an approved isolated owned window with visible title, purpose and associated list label.
cases.action: Separate native UIA client discovers the exact PID/HWND in raw/control views and reads roles, names, label target, selection container and count/positions.
cases.expected: One reachable List/ListItem hierarchy, truthful names/states, correct visible LabeledBy, single-selection settings, checked positions/count and no editable controls.
cases.evidence: Raw/control JSON, pattern/property queries, window/source/binary identities and layout provenance.
cases.blocking_condition: Missing/duplicate/misrelated nodes, label absent, incorrect counts/roles, misleading enabled state or unexpected editable pattern.

cases.setup: At least three fixed rows; selection and keyboard focus recorded independently.
cases.action: Native UIA focuses the list/another button, Selects rows, then reads Focus and Selection independently.
cases.expected: At most one selected row; focus and selection do not falsely follow each other. SelectionContainer/GetSelection agree; single-select Add/Remove behavior has an explicit correct contract.
cases.evidence: Native property/pattern results and correlated UI-thread state trace.
cases.blocking_condition: Focus confused with selection, multiple selected rows, incorrect deselection or contradictory container state.

cases.setup: No process-creation backend enabled; launch-intent boundary and exact owned-process inventory instrumented.
cases.action: Use native UIA Select/AddToSelection/RemoveFromSelection/Focus, pointer row selection and separately labelled physical arrow navigation.
cases.expected: Exactly zero launch intents, service dispatches and fixture launches. Row Click selects only; unchanged Select is idempotent; no row Invoke launches.
cases.evidence: Native action trace, bounded intent/service counters, source call-path review, operator record and owned-process observations; no universal OS-execution proof claimed.
cases.blocking_condition: Any selection/focus action queues or starts launch, or dispatch cannot be observed reliably.

cases.setup: Empty/no-selection, selected, busy, closed and invalid-entry states; Launch records intents only in A.
cases.action: Query/invoke Launch and Refresh through real UIA while disabled/stale; attempt two simultaneous explicit requests.
cases.expected: Enabled state truthful. Disabled/stale requests rejected explicitly; accepted Invoke produces at most one bounded intent. Busy rejects redundancy, never silently succeeds or auto-retries.
cases.evidence: UIA exceptions/results, command/operation IDs, model/status logs and zero process creation in A.
cases.blocking_condition: Silent loss/success, accidental duplicate intent or disabled action accepted.

cases.setup: Controlled fixed-data backend, selected entry in a current snapshot.
cases.action: Request one successful refresh and attempt a redundant refresh; observe pending/running/succeeded and replacement.
cases.expected: One refresh lane; redundant request Busy. Successful refresh ALWAYS clears selection even for same identity; Launch disabled until explicit new selection. No launch.
cases.evidence: Native UIA observations plus gate-controlled backend/consumer logs; injected data clearly labelled.
cases.blocking_condition: Selection silently retained/reselected, redundant scans, missing terminal status or auto-launch.

cases.setup: Controlled delivery gates for old/current fixed snapshots and layout/focus replies.
cases.action: Release newest allowed replies, then deliver an older snapshot/layout/focus response and duplicate completion.
cases.expected: Old/duplicate reply cannot replace current tree/snapshot/focus or corrupt one terminal outcome; checked IDs never wrap into acceptance.
cases.evidence: Real native UIA queries after deterministic injected boundary reorder; state-test evidence labelled injection, not native discovery proof.
cases.blocking_condition: Stale state published, contradictory outcome, identifier reuse or only timing sleeps used to establish order.

cases.setup: Usable snapshot/selection exists; controlled refresh failure, cancellation and partial-source issues.
cases.action: Refresh using each controlled outcome and inspect catalog/status/selection.
cases.expected: Failure/cancellation retains last usable snapshot and selection. Partial success publishes entries/issues, clears selection as new generation and announces truthful partial result.
cases.evidence: Native tree/events, controlled backend outcome record and generation/selection logs.
cases.blocking_condition: Total failure presented as empty success, lost usable state or unannounced exclusions.

cases.setup: Selected and focused row removed by successful replacement; native client retains old row/action objects.
cases.action: Publish replacement then act on retained removed objects; repeat with empty replacement.
cases.expected: Removed identity unavailable/cannot target replacement. Clear selection; logical focus fallback to list or Refresh when empty, with explicit stable announcement.
cases.evidence: Retained-pattern exception/HRESULT trace, raw/control trees and human focus observation.
cases.blocking_condition: Stale action reaches new entry, focus falls off window or unknown target launched.

cases.setup: Separately approved harmless fixture and exact operation-ID ledger; controlled refresh/launch overlap.
cases.action: Dispatch explicit fixture launch, change selection/refresh, and also replace generation before another pending launch dispatch.
cases.expected: Pending stale launch fails without creation; already dispatched success/PID stays tied to original request, not retargeted or hidden by refresh. At most one creation per accepted request.
cases.evidence: Native UIA command trace, real fixture PID/marker and worker/consumer operation logs.
cases.blocking_condition: Retargeting, hidden acceptance, duplicate retry or source-only/mock claim of process behavior.

cases.setup: Owned approved fixture can signal creation and await explicit release; cancellation targeted by ID.
cases.action: Cancel pending request before creation, then separately request cancellation after fixture creation; repeat stale-ID cancellation.
cases.expected: Pre-dispatch cancel creates zero processes. Accepted process is not killed/called cancelled; stale cancellation does not cancel newer work. No claim OS call is preempted.
cases.evidence: Actual fixture handshake/PID/exit records plus consumer state/cancel responses.
cases.blocking_condition: False termination/cancellation claim, wrong-ID effect or UI thread blocked on worker/child.

cases.setup: Owner-approved finite queue capacities C, total request limit and acknowledgement/rejection policy documented.
cases.action: Native clients issue a finite 2C+1 burst through controlled UI-thread processing gates, including removal/close.
cases.expected: Every request has a truthful accepted/rejected disposition; accepted actions applied at most once. Capacity not exceeded, no callback waits for UI reply and no silent successful drop.
cases.evidence: Native outcomes, queue occupancy/high-water/correlation traces and GUI-thread dispatch timing.
cases.blocking_condition: Unknown capacity, silent dropped success, unbounded queue, blocking callback or deadlock.

cases.setup: Native event listener attached before any transition; human Narrator operator present.
cases.action: Run loading/completion/empty/failure, repeat unchanged state, then create a new error occurrence.
cases.expected: One intended live notification per new occurrence; none for unchanged state. Other structure/name events separately identified. Focus stable; human confirms useful nonduplicated feedback.
cases.evidence: Native event IDs/source node/timestamps with model occurrence IDs; separate actual speech observations.
cases.blocking_condition: Events cannot be captured, feedback missing/duplicated, focus moved unexpectedly or speech inferred from source/UIA.

cases.setup: Error/dismiss action visible and focused; retained native action object cached.
cases.action: Dismiss, inspect removal/focus, invoke old action, then recreate an error.
cases.expected: Error/action removed; retained object unavailable and never affects later occurrence; focus moves to specified existing list/action target only when disappearing focus requires it.
cases.evidence: Native tree/event/exception trace and human focus report.
cases.blocking_condition: Old action affects new occurrence, stale nodes persist or dismissal steals external focus.

cases.setup: Named human uses physical keyboard on actual owned window; populated, empty, busy and error states.
cases.action: Traverse Tab/Shift+Tab, use Up/Down/Home/End, activate separate Launch intent/Refresh/Close with Enter/Space and press Escape.
cases.expected: Predictable visible/UIA focus order; disabled actions skipped; rows select without launch; Escape closes only this window. No editable/type-ahead input introduced.
cases.evidence: Per-step physical-input checklist and native focus/event trace; synthetic actions separately identified.
cases.blocking_condition: No human evidence, trapped/lost focus, hidden editable behavior or selection triggers launch.

cases.setup: Narrator started/operated by human under approved existing configuration.
cases.action: Navigate title/purpose/list/rows/actions; select, refresh, inspect empty/error/status and dismiss.
cases.expected: Human can identify/operate controls, hear names/roles/selected state/position/count/enabled/status/errors meaningfully; no unexplained missing/duplicate feedback.
cases.evidence: Per-step heard speech recorded verbatim where available or explicitly labelled operator paraphrase; source/binary/AT identities.
cases.blocking_condition: No operator/speech observation, missing essential information/action or historical attestation reused.

cases.setup: Consenting operator controls a separate ordinary application and returns; prior target valid/closed/replaced cases.
cases.action: Switch away during refresh/error and dismissal; return, close and test restoration denied or target gone.
cases.expected: Zero unsolicited foreground theft; do not restore over a newly selected app. Valid safe restoration only; denial/stale target handled honestly.
cases.evidence: Human chronology plus owned/prior-consented-window focus/activation trace, no unrelated personal data.
cases.blocking_condition: Focus stolen, denial called success or target validity not checked.

cases.setup: Scrollable fixed catalog larger than viewport; actual container ScrollPattern and item ScrollItem verified.
cases.action: Native UIA Scroll/SetScrollPercent and ScrollIntoView; physical keyboard navigate offscreen rows.
cases.expected: Container/item scrolling both work, selected row reachable, offscreen flags/hit points/bounds truthful, no clipped focus/actions and no TextRange inference.
cases.evidence: Native supported-pattern/method/property trace, real row layout/window rectangles and separate visual/human checks.
cases.blocking_condition: Missing container ScrollPattern even if ScrollItem works, unreachable row, hidden truncation or silent pagination substitution.

cases.setup: Host already in approved high-contrast profile; current policy/palette recorded without changing approved designs.
cases.action: Inspect/read/select list and controls, loading/error and disabled states; compare computed/rendered focus/contrast.
cases.expected: Readable actual surfaces/labels; focus distinct from selection without color-only meaning and matching UIA state. Defined composited contrast target satisfied.
cases.evidence: Display/config identity, native state and human observations; measured contrast with method/background, screenshots supplementary.
cases.blocking_condition: Required profile unavailable, unreadable focus/text or contrast target unspecified/failing.

cases.setup: Approved reduced-motion existing host profiles and reactivation procedure; no unapproved setting changes.
cases.action: Open/refresh/dismiss in each profile, reactivate/query preference and inspect any transitions.
cases.expected: Actual policy tracks approved preference; candidate adds no essential animation or polling; no unsolicited motion. Local checkbox history not reused.
cases.evidence: Native preference/model timestamps and human motion observations.
cases.blocking_condition: Cannot exercise profile/reactivation, unwanted animation or only source/local preference used as runtime proof.

cases.setup: Approved DPI profiles covering representative nondefault entry test; existing design recommends 100/125/150/175/200 percent for release.
cases.action: Move/resize owned window and read actual UIA rows/actions at each available approved scale.
cases.expected: Bounds/hit targets/focus agree with real layout and native client origin under documented physical-pixel rounding tolerance; no clipped actions.
cases.evidence: DPI/client/window rectangles, native UIA bounds/actions and layout generation correlation; screenshots supplemental.
cases.blocking_condition: Required scale missing, stale/misaligned bounds or unspecified conversion/tolerance.

cases.setup: Approved mixed-scale two-monitor setup with negative virtual coordinates; no configuration changes implicitly approved.
cases.action: Move owned window across displays; test approved reconnect/primary/work-area changes only with separate configuration permission.
cases.expected: Coordinate signs/scales correct, selection/focus persist safely, stale replies rejected, window stays reachable and no shell reservation exists.
cases.evidence: Monitor bounds/DPI/config record, native UIA geometry/event trace and operator chronology.
cases.blocking_condition: Required configuration unavailable, forced unapproved setting change, unreachable window or stale screen geometry.

cases.setup: Fixed nonpersonal names include accent, surrogate-pair character, combining sequence, ZWJ emoji, RTL and long clusters.
cases.action: Read full UIA names/Narrator; select/scroll/narrow window and compare identity/name/visible presentation.
cases.expected: Truthful complete semantic name and stable identity; visual ellipsis never hides accessible content. Direction/selection remains list state, not invented editable-text geometry.
cases.evidence: Fixture bytes/Unicode identity, native names/bounds/selection trace and human reading.
cases.blocking_condition: Wrong encoding, inaccessible truncation, mismatched row or fabricated range claims.

cases.setup: Owner-approved byte/count/payload limits N and long/malformed metadata corpus, no actual discovery or applications.
cases.action: Submit at N and N+1, NUL/invalid-source metadata, overlarge issue/status payload and unknown/stale IDs.
cases.expected: Checked normalization/rejection with truthful status; no panic, unbounded allocation, silent success, misleading names or launch of invalid entry.
cases.evidence: Fixture hashes/length units, native status/actions and bounded-state/counter records; source policy separate.
cases.blocking_condition: Undefined limits, silent truncation/rejection, encoding corruption or resource bound exceeded.

cases.setup: Same host/build/data profile, approved numeric CPU/memory/response/queue limits; sampler observes only owned process.
cases.action: Measure three 60-second settled idle intervals, hidden and AT-attached separately, plus finite refresh/selection burst and UI responsiveness.
cases.expected: Record CPU-time/wall interval, working set/private memory/handles, queue peaks and response latency; compare approved limits. No guarantee inferred from zero counter delta.
cases.evidence: OS/build/toolchain/data/AT identity, exact sampling method/duration/raw counters and p95/max latency; test sampler distinct from app work.
cases.blocking_condition: Numeric budgets/profile absent, GUI stalls, excess wakeups/queues, unavailable measurement or copied historical baseline.

cases.setup: Controlled fake backend blocks on explicit gate; process/worker ownership instrumented and GUI remains observed.
cases.action: Begin refresh then dismiss/close while worker blocked; release gate and observe final cleanup.
cases.expected: GUI handles dismissal without calling wait/drain_ready/join/shutdown/Drop on GUI thread. No late publication; workers joined off-thread after release. No claimed preemption/bounded OS shutdown.
cases.evidence: Native focus/window/action trace, deterministic gate/thread/owner logs and process exit. Fake blocking explicitly labelled.
cases.blocking_condition: GUI stalls, detached/leaked worker, late publication, false immediate cleanup or gate unavailable.

cases.setup: Exact provider owner/HWND, retained native elements and finite repeat count approved.
cases.action: Hide/show/reactivate, remove rows, close normally, then query retained elements and repeat approved open/close cycles.
cases.expected: No stale element remains actionable; no late tree publication; native/provider ownership ends and owned process exits. No claims about abort or uninterruptible calls.
cases.evidence: Native exception/HRESULT, attach/detach/thread logs, PID/exit/handle observations and before/after inventories.
cases.blocking_condition: Stale action accepted, hidden owned process left, race/deadlock or cleanup inferred from window absence only.

cases.setup: Separate explicit fixture permission, exact harmless executable hash/path/argv/cwd and cleanup protocol approved.
cases.action: Native UIA invokes separate Launch; repeat/replay same request ID, then issue a new explicit approved request.
cases.expected: At most one real fixture creation per accepted request; success normal case one PID, disabled/rejected zero. Receipt means creation only, not ready/foreground. No automatic retry after uncertain outcome.
cases.evidence: Real fixture PID/handshake/argv/cwd/normal-exit record; operation IDs and native Invoke trace; owned-child cleanup.
cases.blocking_condition: Wrong executable, duplicate creation, unknown acceptance retried, arbitrary installed app launch, shell parsing or elevation.

cases.setup: Approved owned fixture can be missing/stale/locked; documented service subset retained.
cases.action: Explicitly launch controlled failing targets, then invoke explicit retry only after new user action.
cases.expected: Structured truthful error and accessible feedback; no unexpected process, shell fallback, privilege retry or automatic relaunch. Selection retained on launch failure unless refresh replaced it.
cases.evidence: Actual native service errors/codes, absence/identity of fixture child, UIA event and human speech evidence.
cases.blocking_condition: Failure called success, auto retry/elevation, discarded request outcome or mocked error claimed native failure.

cases.setup: Owner approves exact Windows build/keyboard/language/display/AT matrix, resource budgets and finite lifetime/repetition cap.
cases.action: Repeat applicable A cases on each declared configuration and finite session cycles; keep blocked and failed results visible.
cases.expected: All mandatory supported rows pass with no unaccounted processes/providers/workers or resource drift above approved threshold; unsupported profiles explicitly excluded.
cases.evidence: Per-profile case results, versions/configs, raw counters/actions/manual speech and integrity manifest.
cases.blocking_condition: Any mandatory unrun/failing case, missing support decision, concealed failure or unverifiable cleanup.
